features.heading: Customer Portal in Giddh
features.subHeading: Share a portal with customers. They view invoices and pay online. Payments sync into your books.

content.heading: Share a dedicated portal with customers
content.description: Giddh provides a Customer Portal feature that allows businesses to share a dedicated portal with their customers for better transparency and communication.

content.heading: Enable portal access and share unique link
content.description: While creating a customer, users can add the customer's email ID and enable access to the customer portal. Giddh then generates a unique link that can be shared with the customer. Using this link, customers can access a secure portal where they can view all the transactions and invoices associated with their business relationship.

content.heading: View invoice PDFs, status, and comments
content.description: Within the portal, customers can view invoice PDFs, invoice statuses (paid, unpaid, or partially paid), and any comments added to the invoices. This provides customers with a centralized place to track all their billing information without having to request updates separately.
more_content: Paid, unpaid, or partially paid status

content.heading: Pay from the portal from the portal
content.description: Additionally, if Giddh is integrated with a payment gateway, customers can make payments directly from the customer portal itself. Once the payment is successfully completed, the corresponding payment entry is automatically recorded in Giddh, reducing manual intervention and keeping the accounting records up to date.
more_content: Accounting records stay up to date

faqs.question: What is the Customer Portal in Giddh?
faqs.answer: Giddh provides a Customer Portal feature that allows businesses to share a dedicated portal with their customers for better transparency and communication.

faqs.question: How do I enable the customer portal?
faqs.answer: While creating a customer, add the customer's email ID and enable access to the customer portal. Giddh then generates a unique link that can be shared with the customer.

faqs.question: What can customers see in the portal?
faqs.answer: Customers can view all transactions and invoices associated with their business relationship, including invoice PDFs, invoice statuses (paid, unpaid, or partially paid), and comments added to the invoices.

faqs.question: Why use the Customer Portal?
faqs.answer: It gives customers a centralized place to track all their billing information without having to request updates separately.

faqs.question: Can customers pay from the portal?
faqs.answer: Yes. If Giddh is integrated with a payment gateway, customers can make payments directly from the customer portal. Once payment is completed, the corresponding payment entry is automatically recorded in Giddh.

faqs.question: Does payment from the portal update my books?
faqs.answer: Yes. Once the payment is successfully completed, the corresponding payment entry is automatically recorded in Giddh, reducing manual intervention and keeping the accounting records up to date.
